description: Takes the use case card (problem, decision supported, expected value, users, accountable owner, human oversight, success metric, fallback without AI), data readiness ratings 1 to 5 (availability, quality, access, freshness, history), yes or no answers to five risk questions (personal data, decisions about people, external effect, money moves, explainability) and the planned controls with owner and status. Returns what is missing, data readiness, open controls, notes where impact is high and oversight low, and a signal following the template rule: proceed only when data, controls and ownership are clear, otherwise pilot, redesign or stop. Checks completeness and controllability; it is not a legal classification, for example under the EU AI Act. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

data.description: Ratings 1 to 5: availability, quality, access, freshness, history.

decision.description: Which decision the AI prepares or takes.

fallback.description: What happens if the AI fails.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

owner.description: Who is responsible for the result.

problem.description: The problem the AI is meant to solve.

risks.description: yes or no: personal_data, decisions_about_people, external_effect, money_moves, explainability.

value.description: Expected value, e.g. hours or euros per year.

name: check_ai_use_case
title: Check a planned AI use case for completeness and control: card, data readiness, risk questions, controls, signal proceed, pilot, redesign or stop
